name: Okura Garden Hotel
detail: This was my second stay this year. I made a reservation because the overall advantages outweighed my curiosity to try other hotels. The cleaning was thorough, and the amenities were abundant. The water quality and pressure were good, the bath was spacious, and in addition to the solid feel of the building, the staff provided a sense of stability, making me feel at ease when returning from outings. I was looking forward to the buffet-style breakfast after swimming in the pool. The hotel is located almost in the center of Shanghai, close to a subway station, and it coexists with both the latest brand buildings and local shops, making for pleasant walks on the premises. Additionally, since it is in the former French Concession area, exploring the surroundings was also enjoyable. I was very satisfied to be able to stay at such a high-quality hotel at a special rate.
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map

name: Jinglai Hotel – Shanghai South Bund Xintiandi Branch
detail: It was so great. I wanted to order delivery, but since my phone number verification didn't work, I asked the staff for help, and I'm so sorry and thankful that they kept placing the order for me. All the staff members were very kind and really nice. The young man spoke English well, so there were no communication problems! Even if there were only staff members who spoke Chinese, they kindly used a translator to guide me in detail, which was great. The check-in time wasn't fixed, so I was able to check in around 11:30 if there was a room available. The checkout time was also at 2 PM, which was very generous and nice. The hygiene was excellent, and the bedding was truly the best. Aside from being about a 13-minute walk from the station, everything else was great. If you take a taxi, you can reach everything within 15 minutes! It was nice. 🥺 If it weren't for the rain, walking wouldn't have been a problem at all... I want to say that this is the best value accommodation, and I plan to stay here every time I come to Shanghai. I really recommend it. 🙏🏻
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map

name: Jinling Purple Mountain Hotel Shanghai
detail: I stayed in a twin room. The room was spacious enough, and it felt more economical compared to the Hotel on the Bund. The staff was very attentive, and I was able to stay comfortably. There were three outlets available that can be used with Japanese plugs. There are convenient dining options at the shopping mall near the station and behind the hotel. It takes about a 5-minute walk to Century Avenue Station. A Didi ride from the airport to the hotel was 120 yuan at 10 PM, and back was 100 yuan at 7 AM. Amenities including toothbrushes were provided.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: Himalayas Hotel Shanghai
detail: The location is excellent for going to the exhibition hall, and the size of the rooms and the quick response for the makeup room are very good. The staff is very friendly, and the breakfast is varied and well-prepared! In particular, the fruits were very fresh and delightful.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: Campanile Hotel - Shanghai Jing'an Temple
detail: Clean, comfortable, spacious room with good facilities in room Good breakfast, helpful staff Ideal for historical centre, transport
area: Jing'an and SHA Railway Station,Shanghai - View on map

name: Golden Tulip Shanghai Hong Qiao
detail: It was truly a place where I experienced proper 4-star hotel service. Many other places that claim to be 4-star often feel more like 2-star, which can be disappointing, but here the atmosphere, room conditions, and service were overall very satisfying. The room was tidy and well-maintained, and the bedding was so comfortable that it was great for a good rest. The bathroom was also clean and well-kept, so I was satisfied throughout my stay. The staff's responses were friendly and attentive, allowing me to have a pleasant experience during my time there. Above all, what I found most satisfying was being able to stay at a hotel of this quality for such a price, and if I go to Shanghai again, it’s a place I would want to visit without hesitation.
area: New Hongqiao Commercial Center and Changning,Shanghai - View on map

name: Shanghai-Pudong
detail: The location and the attitude of the staff were good. The facilities are old, but it is a cost-effective hotel. It was very good, but there were some disappointing points as well. The disappointing points are: 1. The food seemed a bit hard, suggesting it was not freshly made today. 2. The soundproofing is poor. The neighboring room kept opening and closing their door until 1 AM, which woke me up, and for sensitive people, it can be quite annoying. It's not the hotel's fault, but I wonder why they were going in and out until dawn. Aside from those two points, it is a good hotel for the price.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: UrCove by Hyatt Shanghai on the Bund
detail: The location is across from the Huangpu River and the Oriental Pearl, and it is close to Yuyuan Garden. The room condition is top-notch in Shanghai (everything, including the bathroom and bed, is new and very nice). The service is excellent. There is a pleasant scent in the hallways, likely because it is a newly built place. However, it is somewhat far from the heavily visited Nanjing East Road, so please keep that in mind.
area: The Bund and North Bund,Shanghai - View on map

name: Dorsett Shanghai @ Century Park
detail: The hotel is next to Metro Line 2, green line. You can just walk up and enter the hotel. On the ground floor of the hotel, there is a Luckin Coffee as well. Across the street, there is a large public park, Century Park, with a nice atmosphere. If you go in December, the changing leaves are absolutely beautiful. The housekeeping staff is very good. I have stayed there 5-6 times already.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: Shanghai Fish Inn East Nanjing Road
detail: The room condition is much better than expected. It is very spacious, the bed is large, and when you pull back the curtains, sunlight comes in. It's a non-smoking room, so there's no smell of cigarettes at all, and the cleaning staff were very friendly. The location is very close to the center, allowing for a morning run along the Huangpu River, while still being in a quiet alley, which is nice. However, there are two Fish N' locations nearby, so you need to be careful when ordering delivery or taking a taxi. Lastly, there is occasionally a cat on the first floor that is very, very fat and cute. That alone is worth a perfect score.
area: The Bund and North Bund,Shanghai - View on map
